secondary: indic-align Dolly_T Hindi (2000 pairs, ghost-tag demo)
meta.why: An Indic web slice from the Session 3 research family; it exercises the sovereign thread end to end — Brahmic joiners, script-aware quality rules, Assamese/Bengali language-ID confusion, and Indic PII false-positives.

stages.name: Extraction
stages.note: Raw web page -> clean prose. Studied in Session 3; treated as the known upstream stage here.

stages.name: Normalization
stages.note: NFC + strip control/invisible chars + unescape HTML + collapse whitespace, while KEEPING the Brahmic joiners ZWNJ/ZWJ.

stages.name: Format discipline
stages.note: Four incompatible conversation formats rewritten into ONE canonical special-token format; pretraining shards scanned for leaked markers.

stages.name: Quality filtering
stages.note: Script-aware heuristic cascade + educational-value gate. An English-tuned filter would have wrongly dropped good Indic docs.

stages.name: Deduplication (MinHash + LSH)
stages.note: Word-5-gram shingles -> 112-hash MinHash -> 14x8 LSH (FineWeb params). Near-duplicates, not just exact copies.

stages.name: Language ID & validation
stages.note: Detect language at runtime (script-based, Assamese vs Bengali disambiguated on ৰ/ৱ) instead of trusting the folder path.

mismatch_examples.text: ইফালে, ২০জনকৈ লোক আহত হৈছে এই অগ্নিকাণ্ডত।
: হেঃ হেঃ! হয় নেকি? ব’লা ব’লা ইয়াকো লৈ ব’লা।
কৈ তেওঁ মিঠা আলু কেইটা সিজাবলৈ হাতত ল’লে।
যিজনে খেলটো খেলাব, তেওঁ মাজলৈ আহিব।

stages.name: PII removal
stages.note: Regex layer masks emails/phones/IPs/IDs cleanly; name layer shows the precision/recall tension (Indic place-names caught as names).

stages.name: Decontamination
stages.note: Fingerprint the held-out eval set (word-13-grams), remove any training doc that overlaps it, plant a canary for later leak detection.

stages.name: Manifest & reproducibility
stages.note: Content-addressed IDs + a provenance manifest per shard; content hash computed AFTER cleaning; unsafe/unknown licenses block the shard.

extra_defects.title: Half the raw crawl is empty rows
extra_defects.detail: 55,729 of 111,759 raw IndicCorpV2 Assamese rows (49.9%) are blank or whitespace-only — pure wasted tokens that only the cleaning pipeline removes.
